title: Communion
description: A novelist's (Christopher Walken) wife (Lindsay Crouse) and son (Joel Carlson) see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.

title: Charade
description: A suave stranger (Cary Grant) helps a chic widow (Audrey Hepburn) stalked by four men looking for loot in Paris.

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: Bloodfist III: Forced to Fight
description: An innocent half-Asian kickboxer is caught between two other races at war in prison.

title: Candy
description: A fatherly chemistry professor indulges two young lovers in their ever-increasing heroin habits as his life spins out of control.

title: Clockwatchers
description: Friendship helps make nightmarish office jobs bearable for four young women working as temporary employees.

title: The Killing Time
description: A stranger's (Kiefer Sutherland) arrival changes a California sheriff's (Beau Bridges) plan to kill his lover's husband (Wayne Rogers).

title: Prison on Fire 2
description: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son who has been put in an orphanage.

title: Snake and Crane Arts of Shaolin
description: Hsu Yiu Fong (Jackie Chan) guards a powerful book against numerous clans after the eight Shaolin masters who wrote it go missing.

title: The Brood
description: A mad doctor tries psychoplasmic therapy on a raging woman soon to be a mother.

title: Sisters
description: A small-time reporter tries to convince the police she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

title: A Walk to Remember
description: Forced to tutor students at a school, a young delinquent (Shane West) falls for a minister's (Peter Coyote) daughter (Mandy Moore).

title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
description: 17-year-old Tanya and her three siblings are left in the charge of a crotchety old babysitter who suddenly dies. Posing as an adult, Tanya gets an assistant gig at a fashion company and is thrust into the world of adulthood and parenting.

title: The TV Set
description: A network picks up Mike Klein's (David Duchovny) pilot for a TV series, and now he must navigate through one incompetent executive after another, hoping the concept of the show still bears some resemblance to his original idea.

title: Elegy
description: A beautiful student (Penélope Cruz) throws into disarray the life of an aging lecturer and cultural critic (Ben Kingsley) when she awakens in him feelings of sexual possessiveness.

title: Breakfast of Champions
description: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

title: Jiminy Glick in Lalawood
description: A celebrity interviewer (Martin Short) and his wife (Jan Hooks) become tangled in a murder mystery involving a boozy actress, her family and her publicist.

title: Fong Sai-Yuk II
description: A man (Jet Li) dominated by his martial-artist mother (Josephine Hsiao) joins an anti-Manchu society led by a mysterious godfather (Adam Cheng).

title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town.

title: Cobra Verde
description: A Brazilian plantation owner sends an employee (Klaus Kinski) to West Africa to re-establish a slave network.

title: Metroland
description: Urging a bohemian existence, a former schoolmate disrupts a London couple's conventional lifestyle.

title: Drugstore June
description: June is a wannabe influencer who's juggling multiple problems: her parents want her to move out, her ex-boyfriend accuses her of stalking him, and two detectives think she may be involved in the robbery of a local pharmacy.

title: The Exorcist III: Legion
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: Dead Ringers
description: Twin-brother gynecologists (Jeremy Irons) are divided by a patient (Geneviève Bujold) and doomed by drugs.

title: Foreign Correspondent
description: A political assassination plunges an American reporter into international intrigue in pre-World War II Europe.

title: Shade
description: Two grifters join forces with two card players to swindle a legendary gambler in a high-stakes poker game.

title: The Killer
description: Bound by honor and obsession, a Hong Kong hit man (Chow Yun-Fat) and a policeman (Danny Lee) come to respect each other.

title: Villains
description: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

title: Language Lessons
description: When Adam's husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life. However, when tragedy strikes, his teacher becomes a lifeline he didn't know he needed.

title: Chopping Mall
description: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.

title: The Wendell Baker Story
description: An amiable con artist (Luke Wilson) helps retirement-home residents fight back against a mean-spirited nurse (Owen Wilson) who steals their money and treats them like slaves.

title: Dreamscape
description: Two scientists (Kate Capshaw, Max von Sydow) have a psychic (Dennis Quaid) enter other's dreams to help them overcome their nightmares.

title: Deadly Outlaw: Rekka
description: A yakuza (Riki Takeuchi) becomes the target of two clans after the murder of his beloved boss.

title: The Loft
description: Paranoia grips a group of married men (Karl Urban, James Marsden, Wentworth Miller) who find the dead body of an unknown woman in the penthouse they share for extramarital trysts.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: A young woman must foil the terrorist who killed her parents before he strikes again on the island of Nantucket.
An Italian film director (Marcello Mastroianni) seeking the meaning of life retreats from his wife (Anouk Aimée), mistress and flatterers.

title: Hearts Beat Loud
description: In Red Hook, Brooklyn, a father and daughter become an unlikely songwriting duo during the summer before the girl leaves for college.

title: The Dead Girl
description: In a quintet of stories, the murder of a young runaway connects a group of unrelated women (Toni Collette, Rose Byrne, Mary Beth Hurt).

title: Rock 'n' Roll High School
description: A teenager (P.J. Soles) and her friends get even with their principal to music by the Ramones.

title: Fist of Legend
description: A Chinese martial arts student leads his classmates in revolt against Japanese invaders who killed their instructor.

title: Song to Song
description: Two struggling songwriters (Ryan Gosling, Rooney Mara), a music mogul (Michael Fassbender) and a waitress (Natalie Portman) chase success through a rock 'n' roll landscape of seduction and betrayal in Austin, Texas.

title: Police Story
description: A kung-fu policeman must protect a female witness from a Hong Kong drug lord for whom she used to work.

title: The Battle of Algiers
description: Between 1954 and '62, Algeria fights for independence from the French.
